title: Chen Xuan's Last Wish
next_chapter_hook: As blood dripped from Chen Ji's palm, the long-sealed sixth page finally unveiled its mysterious veil—what it recorded was the true cause of death for all previous Chess Players.

text.content: The ink characters on the fragment writhed like living creatures, struggling to break free from millennia of imprisonment. 'Blood for blood, life for life—this is not the way.' Chen Ji stared at this line, his fingertips trembling involuntarily. He could not fathom the true meaning—if it was not a method of trading life for life, then in what form should the price of the Tianji Record's foresight be paid? A hoarse sigh came from behind. Chen Xuan's figure grew increasingly translucent in the dimness, his eyes flickering with complex emotions—gratification, bitterness, and a profound sense of liberation.

dialogue.content: 'You have seen the seventh page.' Chen Xuan walked forward slowly, his withered hand gently stroking the cover of the Tianji Record. 'This sentence is the dying instruction left by the first Chess Player. He was right—blood sacrifice can indeed temporarily suppress the Tianji Record's backlash, but that is merely drinking poison to quench thirst.' He paused, his voice dropping: 'The true solution lies in allowing the Tianji Record to find its true purpose.'

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head abruptly: 'True purpose?' Chen Xuan did not answer directly. Instead, he turned to gaze at the distant horizon shrouded in blood mist. After a long silence, he spoke: 'Do you know the Tianji Record was originally created not to foresee the future?' His voice grew ethereal: 'In ancient times, seven great cultivators attempted to challenge the Heavens' chess game. They jointly forged a divine artifact to shatter the board manipulating all beings' fates. The Tianji Record...was the core of that artifact.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply: 'Challenge the Heavens?' 'Precisely.' Chen Xuan turned around, and within those clouded eyes burned a sudden flame: 'Unfortunately, those seven great cultivators ultimately all failed. They were erased by the Eyes of Heavenly Judgment, their souls transformed into the seven page fragments of the Tianji Record. And all predictors throughout history who have wielded the Tianji Record were merely...replacements sought by the Heavens in the mortal realm.' His voice carried infinite desolation: 'I am one of them. For a hundred years, I have been merely a discarded piece in its grasp.'

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. He gazed at this elderly figure, remembering his century-spanning machinations, his obsession with the Chen bloodline, his resolute choice to appear despite knowing death was inevitable. From the beginning, Chen Xuan understood he was merely a chess piece. All he had done was struggle within the grand game itself, leaving future generations a slim chance of survival. 'Ancestor,' Chen Ji spoke, his voice somewhat hoarse: 'What do you wish me to do?'

dialogue.content: Chen Xuan smiled, that smile carrying both liberation and anticipation. 'I want you...to personally send me off.' Chen Ji's entire body trembled. Chen Xuan continued: 'The reason my decrepit form still exists is due to the power lingering in my bloodline from the Eyes of Heavenly Judgment. As long as I remain alive, it can track the Tianji Record's location through me. But if I die, this connection will be severed...' He raised his hand to grasp Chen Ji's hand holding the Tianji Record: 'You will gain three hours of respite. Within these three hours, the Eyes of Heavenly Judgment cannot lock onto your existence.'

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his gaze to the hand Chen Xuan grasped—the fingers were withered like dead wood yet carried burning warmth. He parted his lips, wishing to speak, yet discovered his throat seemed obstructed. 'I understand this is exceedingly cruel for you,' Chen Xuan whispered: 'But I have observed you for a hundred years. From your childhood, enduring humiliation without outburst, to your gradual scheming, eliminating enemies, winning over hearts...you are no longer the waste others once trampled upon.' His gaze softened: 'You deserve to know all of this. And deserve...to make your own choice.'

choice.prompt: Chen Xuan's request cast Chen Ji into silence. This ancestor manipulated by fate his entire life now regarded him with an almost imploring gaze. A century of planning, all for this moment of entrustment.

choices.description: Chen Xuan spent his entire life paving the way for future generations, now only seeking liberation. As a junior, he could not refuse this weighty last wish.
choices.visible_cost: Endure the pain of personally sending off the ancestor
choices.visible_reward: Gain three hours of heavenly屏蔽 period
choices.risk_hint: Chen Xuan's death may trigger unknown variables

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, slowly kneeling, performing three kneelings and nine kowtows before Chen Xuan. This was the most solemn courtesy a Chen descendant could offer an ancestor, also his final reverence for this elderly man. 'Ancestor, depart in peace,' his voice trembled yet each word rang clear: 'Your unfinished cause, I shall accomplish in your stead.'

choices.description: Chen Ji was unwilling to accept this method of trading death for time; he wished to find a solution beneficial to all.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain Chen Xuan's existence to obtain more intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly tracking may descend at any moment

text.content: 'Wait.' Chen Ji raised his hand to halt Chen Xuan's motion: 'Ancestor, I refuse to believe this world offers only the path of trading death for life. Let me think...' He closed his eyes, the Tianji Record rapidly turning within his mind. Yet within the blurry visions, only a blood-red light was approaching—time remaining for him was nearly exhausted.

Chen Xuan observed Chen Ji's choice, a glint of approval flickering in his eyes. He did not urge, merely waiting silently as if accustomed to waiting. Yet Chen Ji understood time was running out. The blood-red light within the Tianji Record was rapidly expanding—that was the tracking technique of the Eyes of Heavenly Judgment. Should they hesitate even a moment longer, everyone would be exposed beneath Heavenly surveillance. Chen Ji clenched his fists. He recalled the scene from childhood when he first saw Chen Xuan's portrait in the old Chen residence, every clue about his ancestor gathered secretly over these years. This elderly man before him was his sole blood relative in this world.

'Ancestor.' Chen Ji spoke again, his voice considerably calmer this time: 'Before I send you off, do you have any unfinished wishes?' Chen Xuan fell silent for a moment, then produced a yellowed Jade Slip from his怀. Etched upon it was an ancient seal, and at the seal's center bloomed a verdant lotus. 'This is the final legacy left by our Chen ancestors,' Chen Xuan placed the Jade Slip into Chen Ji's palm: 'Within is sealed a wisp of your sister Chen Nian's consciousness. When she was taken by the Holy Sect, I exhausted every effort to intercept a fragment of her soul.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's hands trembled violently. He received the Jade Slip, and when his fingertips touched that familiar lotus seal, a sensation of blood connection surged through his heart. 'Niannian...' he murmured softly, his voice carrying long-suppressed longing. Chen Xuan sighed: 'This wisp of consciousness can help you locate her true form. But I must warn you—the reason the Holy Sect spared her life is because her bloodline contains a special power. This power...is connected to the Tianji Record.'

text.content:
"Chen Ji raised his head abruptly: "Does it have something to do with the Tianji Record?"

"That's right." Chen Xuan's form had already faded to near transparency. "The year Chen Nian was taken away was precisely when the sixth page of the Tianji Record appeared. I've always suspected that the Eye of Heaven took her because her bloodline carries the key to... opening the seventh page."

He paused, his voice growing urgent: "So before you grow strong enough, don't go looking for her. She is now your greatest weakness, the bargaining chip Heaven uses to threaten you."

choice.prompt: Chen Xuan was about to dissipate, but his final words still echoed. Before accepting this heavy entrustment, Chen Ji needed to demonstrate his resolve.

choices.text: Inheriting the Ancestor's Wish | I Will Find Chen Nian
choices.description: No matter how perilous the road ahead, he had to find his sister. This was his duty as a brother, his promise to his parents.
choices.visible_cost: Exposed Under the Threat of the Holy Sect
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Complete Inheritance of the Chen Family Bloodline
choices.risk_hint: Might Precisely Fall Into the Heavenly Dao's Trap

text.content:
"I will find her." Chen Ji carefully tucked away the jade slip, his gaze resolute. "Not just for the ancestor's wish, but for myself. Niannian is my only attachment in this world."

He raised his head, meeting Chen Xuan's eyes directly: "Rest assured, I won't let her wait too long."

choices.memory_label: 陈机下定决心寻找妹妹陈念

choices.text: Walking Alone First | Perfect the Tianji Record First
choices.description: Before having sufficient strength, recklessly searching for Chen Nian would only put her in greater danger. Become stronger first, then save her.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian May Endure Even More Suffering
choices.risk_hint: Inner Guilt Will Intensify Over Time

text.content:
"I will find her." Chen Ji tucked the jade slip close to his body, his eyes flickering with restrained intensity. "But not now."

He clenched his fists until his knuckles turned white: "Niannian has waited all these years; a little longer won't matter. When I've gathered all the power of the Tianji Record, when I have enough chips to contend with the Holy Sect... I will definitely bring her back."

choices.text: Seeking Allies | Unite to Oppose the Heavenly Dao
choices.description: One person's power is limited. To oppose an existence like the Eye of Heaven, one must find reliable allies to plan together.
choices.risk_hint: Allies May Have Their Own Self-Interest

text.content:
"Ancestor, there is something I don't understand." Chen Ji pondered. "Since the Eye of Heaven is so powerful, relying on my strength alone would be insufficient to contend with it. Do you know, among the forces and figures in this world, who has opposed the Heavenly Dao?"

A glimmer of relief flickered in Chen Xuan's eyes: "You've asked the right question. Although those seven great cultivators fell, their descendants still secretly continue their will..."

Chen Xuan's voice grew increasingly weak, his form more translucent. He knew time was running out, so he quickened his pace: "The descendants of those seven great cultivators are scattered among the major sects. Some have declined, some have hidden their names, but the blood in their veins still carries the determination to oppose the Heavenly Dao."

"Tianqing Sect, Xuanwu Sect, White Tiger Sect—the deepest parts of these three major sects all contain their traces." Chen Xuan pointed toward Chen Ji's chest. "And the Tianji Record fragment in your hands is precisely the key that strings all of this together."

His form began to dissolve like dust: "Remember, the true enemy is never any single person, but the Eye of Heaven that sits above all, treating all things as chess pieces..."

Before his words finished, Chen Xuan's form had already faded to nearly invisible. He glanced at Chen Ji one last time, those eyes held expectation, reluctance, and a sense of relief like a burden finally lifted.

"Go ahead, child." His voice was like a candle guttering in the wind. "Let me... complete this final journey with dignity."

Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record tightly, the sharp page edges cutting his palm. Blood trickled between his fingers. He gazed at this ancestor who had been manipulated by fate his entire life, an endless sorrow rising in his heart.

dialogue.content:
"Ancestor, may you journey well."

Chen Ji knelt on one knee, raising the Tianji Record high. The inscriptions on the fragment burst forth with dazzling golden light, which enveloped Chen Xuan's dissipating form.

Chen Xuan slightly nodded, finally revealing a relieved smile: "I... can finally rest."

The golden light grew brighter and brighter. Chen Xuan's form gradually faded within the radiance, eventually transforming into scattered starlight that merged into the Tianji Record. His voice drifted from the depths of the pages, carrying infinite ease: "The sixth page of the Tianji Record... has opened its gate to you. Go forth, complete the cause we could not finish..."

text.content:
The moment Chen Xuan completely dissipated, the entire old residence shook violently. Cracks spread across the blue stone ground beneath Chen Ji's feet, and a majestic power erupted from the depths of the earth, flowing upward against his meridians.

It was the ancient seal long dormant within the Chen family bloodline, now beginning a chain reaction due to the gathering of bloodline inheritors. Golden patterns spread from Chen Ji's feet, clinging to his body like living things, ultimately converging at his chest into a faintly visible green lotus mark.

Chen Ji grunted, that power too vast, almost on the verge of bursting his meridians. Yet just then, the Tianji Record flipped violently, stopping at a page that had never appeared before—

It was a completely blank page, but as Chen Xuan's residual power poured in, lines of golden characters began to slowly emerge. This was the sixth page of the Tianji Record, the forbidden page recording the true causes of death of generations of Chess Players.

"Using blood to repay blood, using life to end life—this is not the way—" The true meaning of these words is..." Chen Ji's eyes widened as he read the terrifying contents word by word.

"'Throughout the ages, no Chess Player has ever died from Heavenly Fate backlash—they all perished to the harvest of the Eye of Heaven.'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The characters on the sixth page grew increasingly clear, and with each word he read, his heart sank further.

So it turned out that Heavenly Fate Value was not merely a consumable resource, but a mark by which Heaven marked its prey. The higher the Heavenly Fate Value accumulated by each Chess Player, the more easily they would be locked onto by the Eye of Heaven. The moment the Heavenly Fate Value was depleted was precisely when Heaven would harvest them.

And Chen Xuan's choice of death was precisely to sever this connection, allowing Chen Ji to escape the fate of being harvested."

dialogue.content:
"A hoarse voice drifted out from the depths of the Tianji Record—the remnant soul of Mo Xiansheng had been awakened from his slumber.

'You've finally learned the truth.' There was a trace of relief in Mo Xiansheng's voice. 'But this is merely the beginning. The sixth page only reveals Heaven's conspiracy—the seventh page... is the key to truly breaking the chess game.'

After a pause, his voice turned low: 'And the key to the seventh page lies within your sister Chen Nian's bloodline. This is precisely why the Eye of Heaven refuses to let her go.'"

text.content:
"Chen Ji tightly gripped the Jade Slip in his hand, his knuckles white from the force. His sister Chen Nian's image surfaced in his mind—the little girl who forever remained seven years old in his memories, now imprisoned in the depths of the Holy Sect, enduring unimaginable suffering.

'Niannian...' he murmured softly, 'Brother will definitely come to rescue you.'

The golden light on the Tianji Record gradually faded, and the characters on the sixth page stabilized. However, just at this moment, a blood-red light came racing across the distant horizon—the Eye of Heaven had finally detected Chen Xuan's death and began tracking the Tianji Record's whereabouts."

"Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying urgency: 'Go quickly! Chen Xuan's death has bought you three hours, but after that, the Eye of Heaven will re-lock onto your position. Three hours... is enough time for you to do many things.'

Chen Ji took a deep breath and tucked both the Tianji Record and Jade Slip into his chest. He cast one final glance at where Chen Xuan had dissipated—there remained only a wisp of faint starlight, drifting gently in the night wind.

'Ancestor, rest in peace.' he said quietly, 'Your dying wish, I, Chen Ji, have received.'

Turning around, Chen Ji vanished like a phantom shadow, disappearing into the night. Ahead awaited him unknown roads, lurking dangers, and that惊天 secret that had been sealed for a thousand years."
